approaches.title: Dynamic programming over the previous three stairs
approaches.summary: Compute the minimum cost to reach each stair using jumps of one to three stairs, adding the destination cost and squared jump length. The initial implementation stores all DP values; the revision expresses the same recurrence with rolling state for constant space.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Uses an array and forward relaxation to update the minimum cost for each stair, evaluating jump costs with Math.pow.
